name: Can you convert an existing bathtub into a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can you convert an existing bathtub into a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, tub-to-shower conversions are among the most common bathroom projects. Removing an alcove bathtub creates space for a spacious walk-in shower with custom tile, built-in niches, and frameless glass doors. The main tradeoff involves resale value: keeping at least one functioning bathtub elsewhere in the house is generally recommended for families with small children. The conversion requires adapting the existing drain size, adjusting rough-in plumbing, and installing reliable shower pan waterproofing before laying floor and wall tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Bathtubs can be removed and replaced with custom walk-in tile showers, provided the drain size is adapted and a proper waterproof shower pan is installed.
